description: Bulk-adds items to a collection with per-item errors keyed by field key. Use it to move a hard-coded list (a menu array in a component, rows from a CSV) into a collection. Run with dryRun: true (the default) first; saving (dryRun: false) needs explicit confirmation. Accepts up to 2000 items, sent in batches; retrying the same call doesn't duplicate items.

dryRun.description: Validate only (default true), e.g. false to save after the user confirmed.

slug.description: URL form of the item, e.g. "margherita".

values.description: Values keyed by field key (see get_collection_schema), e.g. { "name": "Margherita", "price": 14 }.

mode.description: valid_only (default) saves the valid items; all_or_nothing saves nothing if any item is invalid, e.g. "all_or_nothing".

name: add_collection_items
title: Add collection items
